overview.description: The Thornburg Premium Income Builder ETF (THOR) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund targets income-producing investments through dividend-paying equity securities from around the world. To generate additional income, the actively managed ETF opportunistically employs an option strategy. THOR was launched on Jun 22, 2026 and is issued by Thornburg.
